page.overview:
Who is Joiya Byir?

Joiya Byir was a Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah. She was also Black Ajah and a member of Liandrin's Group of Black Sisters

Joiya appeared to be a handsome woman, with a friendly, motherly face, dark gray eyes and dark hair.

Joiya is weak in the One Power for an Aes Sedai, with a strength level of . She was the weakest among Liandrin's group of Black Sisters.

Joiya was 171 years old when she died. She was born in and went to the White Tower in . After spending nine years as a novice and eleven years as Accepted, she was raised to the shawl in .
